svg.title: One filter, three stops
svg.desc: The same three by three filter window shown at three positions on a five by five grid that holds one bright vertical line. The answers are plus 765, then zero, then minus 765.
svg.text: warm-up image: one bright line on a dark background / filter: -1 0 +1 in all three rows
The pink window slides one step right each time. Same nine weights - three different answers.
